name: content-harness
description: A generic, client-agnostic content production harness: eight Claude Code skills that onboard a new client's brand/voice/channel config, load that brand context, enforce every production rule, gate quality, produce on-voice content across whatever channels the client actually wants, and learn from corrections over time. Invoke a skill by name, e.g. /onboard, /generate-batch, /validate, /linkedin-check, /retro. Ships with zero channels configured and placeholder brand docs; run /onboard first. Requires the Project to be linked to a folder containing brand/, rules/, src/, outputs/ for the skills to read the brand docs.
